capabilities: Break a selected note into atomic notes via the OpenAI API
Add frontmatter with the date to each generated note
Attach custom tags configured in settings to new notes
Trigger atomization from the command palette or a sidebar icon
extras: README includes a network usage disclosure: note content is sent to api.openai.com for processing, and users are pointed to OpenAI's privacy policy.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to automatically decompose a large note into smaller atomic notes with extracted key insights.

relations.evidence: Sends selected note to OpenAI for processing

summary: AI plugin that breaks large notes into atomic notes using the OpenAI API, adding dated frontmatter and configured tags to each new note.
